mapper.sql: user_no, sp_user_id, role_code, tc_id, stdt_id, status, provisioned, last_login_at, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.update: /* UserMapper.updateUser */ UPDATE `user` SET sp_user_id = #{spUserId}, role_code = #{roleCode}, tc_id = #{tcId}, stdt_id = #{stdtId}, status = #{status}, provisioned = COALESCE(#{provisioned}, provisioned), last_login_at = #{lastLoginAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE user_no = #{userNo}
/* UserMapper.markWithdrawn */ UPDATE `user` SET status = 'WITHDRAWN', tc_id = NULL, stdt_id = NULL, sp_user_id = NULL, updated_by = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_no = #{userNo}
mapper.delete:
/* UserMapper.deleteOrphanProvisionedUsers */
DELETE u FROM `user` u WHERE u.provisioned = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_member gm WHERE gm.user_no = u.user_no AND gm.status = 'ACTIVE') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_info gi WHERE gi.host_user_no = u.user_no)
